objective: Proof: under the fewest counts chains of offshoots are born only at offshoots of demand at most 1; stalls happen only in round 1; m chains born with one common partner grow m-dimensionally; the largest dimension within five knots of five places.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): under the fewest counts only round 1 can stall (Lemma 1); surplus arises only at one-parent junctions of demand at most 1 and through relays (Lemma 2). The conjectured chain rule was refuted as stated by the census: 145 plus-one exceptions and birthless rings of five knots.
title: Why chains decide the dimension
